name: Power Pro Kun Pocket 8
original_name: パワプロクンポケット8
source:
Main character works in the cyborg countermeasure room (commonly called CCR) . Cyborgs have infiltrated the Hoppers team and are plotting something. Protagonist becomes a member of the Hoppers to examine the matter closely.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在赛博格对策室（简称CCR）工作。赛博格已经渗透进入跳跃者队，正在策划某件事。主人公加入跳跃者队，调查事情真相。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndreview[/url]]
